A reading-progress rail that scrubs by touch, drag and keyboard, with a hover readout, chapter ticks and a thumb that follows the finger. It is a scrubbing surface, not a value field, so Base UI's Slider (a field with a track and a thumb) does not fit it.

The player's seek bar is a native range input laid over a progress bar. It is a scrubbing surface that the media element drives while it plays, and the native input keeps its touch and keyboard behaviour for free.

The theme choice (Light, Sepia, Dark, System) is kept per profile on the server (persistPreference), not on the device, and sepia stays as a reading theme beside light and dark. A first visit is light; System resolves to light or dark and writes that to data-theme.
Inline style holds colours from the --theme-<name>-* constants, which a picker has to paint all at once, whichever theme is active. Utilities can't reach a theme that is not the one showing.
Inline style holds computed geometry (the sheet's size and pan, text boxes, pen widths) and the ink swatches' colour, which is a token the palette resolves at pick time.
